quests.hint: Subordinate phrase 'Insofar as' qualifies an exceptionally strong epistemological synthesis.
quests.explanation: Insofar as any framework reconciles internalist justification with externalist reliability (qualifying phrase) + this synthesis comes closer than most rivals (main clause). quests.textToSpeak: Insofar as any framework reconciles internalist justification with externalist reliability, this synthesis comes closer than most rivals.

quests.hint: Formal inverted conditional describing a transformative scientific achievement.
quests.explanation: Were quantum mechanics and general relativity finally unified (formal inverted conditional) + the framework would demand reconceptualizing spacetime itself (hypothetical result). Unifying these two theories remains one of the most significant unsolved problems in physics.
quests.textToSpeak: Were quantum mechanics and general relativity finally unified, the framework would demand reconceptualizing spacetime itself.

quests.explanation: Notwithstanding the framework's sophistication in reconciling intuitions about identity (formal contrast phrase) + it cannot accommodate certain genuinely pathological edge cases (main clause). quests.textToSpeak: Notwithstanding the framework's sophistication in reconciling intuitions about identity, it cannot accommodate certain genuinely pathological edge cases.

quests.textToSpeak: Far from the decisive confirmation proponents claim, this finding establishes at most a fragile, unreplicated correlation.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate clause 'Much as' introduces concession before noting a growing scholarly challenge.

quests.hint: Subordinate clause 'Provided that' sets a precondition tied to resolving an ancient puzzle.
quests.explanation: Provided one accepts its demanding metaphysical commitments (precondition) + the revisionary account resolves a puzzle confounding philosophers for millennia (result). Revisionary metaphysical theories often trade increased commitment for greater explanatory elegance.
quests.textToSpeak: Provided one accepts its demanding metaphysical commitments, the revisionary account resolves a puzzle confounding philosophers for millennia.

quests.hint: Subordinate clause 'Whatever' introduces unconditional concession before an observation.
quests.explanation: Whatever one's verdict on moral realism (unconditional concession) + ordinary discourse proceeds as though objective evaluative facts were simply assumed (observation). The phenomenology of moral discourse is sometimes invoked as indirect evidence for realism.
quests.textToSpeak: Whatever one's verdict on moral realism, ordinary discourse proceeds as though objective evaluative facts were simply assumed.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.

quests.explanation: Short of abandoning correspondence theories of truth (extreme alternative) + philosophers face an intricate thicket of unresolved technical solutions (consequence). The liar paradox has generated an extensive and still-unresolved technical literature.
quests.textToSpeak: Short of abandoning correspondence theories of truth, philosophers face an intricate thicket of unresolved technical solutions.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Inverted concessive clause with embedded formal validation detail.
quests.explanation: Subject (The apparatus) + internally coherent though formal analysis demonstrates (inverted concessive clause) + rests on axioms whose justification remains a matter of intuition (main verb). quests.textToSpeak: The apparatus, internally coherent though formal analysis demonstrates, rests on axioms whose justification remains a matter of intuition.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate phrase 'In as much as' qualifies an ambitious naturalistic project.
quests.explanation: In as much as naturalism bridges descriptive facts and prescriptive claims (qualifying phrase) + this project surpasses most comparable attempts (main clause). The fact-value gap, articulated by Hume, remains a central challenge for naturalistic theories.
quests.textToSpeak: In as much as naturalism bridges descriptive facts and prescriptive claims, this project surpasses most comparable attempts.

quests.hint: Inverted third conditional reflecting on a pivotal philosophical moment.
quests.explanation: Had the analytic-synthetic distinction never faced the Quinean critique that dismantled it (inverted third conditional) + epistemology would look very different (hypothetical result). quests.textToSpeak: Had the analytic-synthetic distinction never faced the Quinean critique that dismantled it, epistemology would look very different.

quests.explanation: To the extent that any theory of consciousness addresses the hard problem rather than redescribing it (qualifying phrase) + opinion remains divided (main clause). The hard problem of consciousness remains a stubbornly resistant puzzle in philosophy of mind.
quests.textToSpeak: To the extent that any theory of consciousness addresses the hard problem rather than redescribing it, opinion remains divided.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Inverted concessive clause with embedded critique of a fallacy.
quests.explanation: Subject (The argument) + formally valid though it is (inverted concessive clause) + depends on a question-begging premise few outside the tradition accept (main verb). Formal validity guarantees only that conclusions follow, not that premises are justified.
